overview: Kawartha Lakes had 79,247 residents in 2021, up 5.1% from 75,423 in 2016, spread across 3,033.66 square kilometres in 32,708 occupied homes. The median age is 51.6, among the oldest in Ontario, and the median household income in 2020 was $82,000.

Customers are scattered across many small towns, and seasonal visitors swell demand in summer. A local business has to reach an older, spread-out audience and still catch cottage traffic when the lakes fill up.
